Damage Claims

All damages shall be repaired within 2
weeks. Agency reserves the right to
withhold payment on all outstanding
invoices until all damage rectifications are
met.

Article 2 of Detailed Specifications

Contractors Qualifications/

The Contractor must have at least 3 years of
experience in the testing, maintenance and
repair of the systems and equipment
described herein. The Contractor shall have
been in continuous business for a minimum of
three (3) years prior to the bid opening date,
actively and commercially providing the full
scope of services required under this contract,
including those related to project size and
complexity. In the case of a joint venture, at
least one member of the joint venture must
meet this three (3) year minimum
requirement.

Equipment List

Prior to award, the Contractor must submit
the names and contact information of at least
two (2) client organizations that can verify the
